notes.title: Release 1.0.1
notes.content:
The first update for Apple Run is here! It consists of small but important changes and improvements to make the overall experience better.

Full changelist:
-Fixed: Golden apples not displaying a collect effect
-Improved: Golden apples now don't touch the wall 
-Added: Version identification text on main menu
-Changed: Golden apples now add score at the end of the collect effect
